title: Symbolic Dynamics in connection with combinatorics on words, number theory and geometry.
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with Lahore College for Women University
about: CIMPA research school at Lahore College for Women University, 15-26 March 2027, on symbolic dynamics and its links with combinatorics on words, number theory and geometry, including tilings, Diophantine approximation and substitutions. Applications close 15 November 2026.
requirements: CIMPA schools are aimed mainly at students and teacher-researchers in developing countries
Applications must be made via the CIMPA application site before the deadline on the school's page
